subTitle: Ask us anything about our services, pricing, and process — honest answers from the Re-EL team.

faqs.question: What graphic design services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer logo design, business cards, flyers, posters, brochures, banners, stickers, and full brand identity packages. All items have transparent ZAR pricing — browse our Services page and add items to your cart for a WhatsApp quote.

faqs.question: Do you build websites and mobile apps?
faqs.answer: Yes. We develop custom responsive websites, web apps, e-commerce stores, and Android, iOS, and Windows applications. Every build is tailored to your business goals with clear milestones and local support.

faqs.question: How does the cart and quote process work?
faqs.answer: Add graphic design items to your cart on the Services page, then send your order via WhatsApp. We'll confirm scope, timeline, and final pricing. For web and app projects, book a free consultation to get a custom proposal.

faqs.question: What kind of support can I expect after launch?
faqs.answer: All clients receive dedicated email and WhatsApp support. We offer post-launch care, updates, and ongoing design retainers so your brand keeps performing as you grow.

faqs.question: Are you based in South Africa?
faqs.answer: Yes — Re-EL is a Johannesburg-based creative agency. We work with clients across Gauteng and nationwide, with pricing in ZAR and an understanding of local market needs.

faqs.question: Can you handle large or multi-phase projects?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. From full rebrands to complex web platforms, we follow a proven Discover → Design → Build → Launch process. Contact us for enterprise solutions and phased delivery plans.
